QuestInfo.name: Fairy Fountain
QuestInfo.0: The Elluel I saw when I awoke was still under the curse of the Black Mage. Even the elves who were free seemed like they were trapped in a dream.
QuestInfo.1: The elves are trapped in a dream created by the fake Mercedes. You can't just leave them like this. You need #t4034075# from the #m101050020# to awaken the elves.
QuestInfo.2: You used #t4034075# to awaken the elves. Most of them said they were happier in their dreams, but Philius looked like he was trapped in a nightmare.

0.msg: Philius, Philius! Ahh, it's no use. I can't just shake him out of an enchanted dream. They seem to know they're dreaming, and yet... I must do something.\r\n

1.msg: Mercedes mentioned the #b#m101050020##k... Water that washes away all bad things. I wonder if that would awaken the elves.

0.msg: I must find the #rFountainhead Pillar#k first. They said it was at the highest point in Fairy Forest, so it should be this way.

1.msg: Are you okay? I'm guessing you were having a nightmare from all the cold sweats. It seemed like the other elves were having better dreams than you.

2.msg: Dream? Was I... dreaming? Wait, you are...

default.0: (Philius has fallen into a deep sleep. He sounds like he is having a nightmare.)
